content.text:
The Pale Harvest quest is finished and the game is over.

I killed the drowned sailor and captain at the wreck, took the strongbox key from the captain, and opened the strongbox. Inside was a Kothringi Keystone, not the Eye itself. I brought it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom and she paid me 100 gold.

Nesh-Deeka didn't recognise the keystone but says the carving is Kothringi. The next lead is the Chime-Keepers of Toklea, in the Tulmek Washes. Their elder, in the old Kothringi greathouse, should know what it is.

She also said the Unbound have not been to the wreck. When I asked how she knew, she only said "we listen". I don't trust that answer.

I submitted my final notes with the last `answer` command.
